Mexico.name: Miguel
Mexico.intro_message: It's good to see you again.
Mexico.intro_speech: Hi! It's good to see you again.
Mexico.ending_message: Perfect! I hope to see you again! Bye-bye!
Mexico.finale_message:
내 나라에 놀러 와 줘서 고마워, 친구야!
Bye-bye, my friend!

tts.instructions: Speak like a cheerful and friendly young boy. Use a light, clear, youthful voice with a moderately higher pitch and a warm smile. Speak at a steady, relaxed pace for Korean third-grade English learners. Sound playful and upbeat, but never rushed, breathless, deep, mature, or formal. Use clear American English. Do not add or change any words.
